_comment: Long-form per-game data consumed by the about pages and by the JSON-LD generator in src/data/games.ts. Structured fields (genre, robloxGameId, etc.) mirror catalog data so a single source can populate both schema.org markup and the LLM-facing /llms.txt without re-reading the engineering catalog. Fields are intentionally optional on the consumer side; missing values are dropped from schema output.

body: The Furries control the town. The town pays contractors to recover it.
The contractors start at Whiskerhold. The Furries control the other six territories at the start of the round.
Each Furry type has a different function. Some Furries use melee attacks, and other Furries use ranged or explosive attacks.
Traditional has a time limit of 48 minutes. Rush has a time limit of 7 minutes and 30 seconds. Infection has a time limit of 15 minutes.
The game has weapons, ground vehicles, and helicopters. These items do not make a combat area safe.
The tunnel route opens after the contractors recover all six Furry territories in Traditional. A large unnamed man is in the boss area.
features: The map has seven territories. The contractors control one territory when the round starts.
The game has eight regular Furry types. These types use melee, ranged, explosive, and support functions.
The game has three modes: Traditional, Rush, and Infection.
The game has weapons, ground vehicles, and helicopters.
The boss route opens after the contractors recover all six Furry territories in Traditional.
